rows.text: Genius Society #3 Nyul Iman once recreated a black hole in her laboratory, and people speculated she was seeking the essence of Nihility. Three weeks later, she modified the Synthetic Black Hole into a cotton candy machine that automatically dispensed sweets to passing children, which led onlookers to suspect her true study was Voracity. The Fools offered a simpler hypothesis: perhaps she was just curious about what a black hole might taste like. In the end, she made far too much for one person to ever eat alone.
